title: Getting Ready: Access and Environment Verification

items.heading: Preparing for Secure AI Assistant Integration
items.paragraph: Before you can safely connect AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT to your tools and data, it’s essential to ensure your environment and accounts are properly set up. A secure and smooth setup is the foundation for leveraging connectors responsibly, protecting your information, and making the most of what the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has to offer. This lesson will guide you through the critical steps to verify your readiness for secure AI integration.
Get ready to start your MCP journey by understanding exactly what you’ll accomplish in this lesson. Here are the learning objectives you’ll achieve:

Requisito técnico: internet ativa e conta Claude em qualquer plano. Diferentemente de outros recursos do Claude, os conectores MCP estão disponíveis também no plano gratuito, com o limite de um conector personalizado; os conectores do Google Workspace e as extensões do Claude Desktop estão disponíveis a todos os usuários. No ChatGPT, a disponibilidade de Plugins e de servidor MCP personalizado varia por plano e por conta e não foi confirmada para todos os planos; por isso, o ChatGPT é utilizado apenas como variação.

📌 Planos, requisitos e rótulos de interface foram extraídos da documentação oficial da Anthropic, da OpenAI e do projeto MCP consultada em 17/10/2026. A ajuda mais recente está, em grande parte, apenas em inglês; os rótulos são apresentados em inglês com a tradução provável entre parênteses. Itens marcados com [conferir] devem ser validados antes da publicação.

items.heading: Required Accounts and Resources
items.paragraph: Explore each section below to review the required accounts and resources for this course. Expand each item for details and tips to ensure you’re ready to proceed.

items.title: Claude Account (Plans and Slots)
items.description: You’ll need a Claude account—any plan will work, including Free, Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise. The free plan allows one custom connector; if you already have one installed, you’ll need to remove it before adding another. Google Workspace connectors and Claude Desktop extensions are available to all users.

items.title: Claude Desktop (System Requirements)
items.description: Claude Desktop is required for certain modules and is available for macOS 13 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+ or Debian 12+, beta). Make sure your system meets these requirements before proceeding. If you’re on a corporate device, installation may require IT approval; a web alternative is available if needed.

items.title: Personal Google Account (Usage Guidance)
items.description: A personal Google account is needed for exercises involving Google Workspace connectors. Avoid using work or school accounts, as organizational policies may restrict connector access. Using a personal account ensures full functionality and avoids data privacy issues.

items.title: ChatGPT Account (Plugin/MCP Availability)
items.description: ChatGPT’s support for Plugins or custom MCP servers varies by plan, region, and account. Some accounts show these features as "Plugins" or "Apps". If unavailable, simply note this and complete all activities using Claude—no paid plan is required for this course.

items.title: Prepare for MCP Integration
items.description: Begin by preparing your accounts and devices for MCP integration. This process will help you confirm that you have everything needed for the course exercises.

items.title: Confirm Your Readiness
items.description: Once you’ve completed these steps, you’ll have a clear record of your readiness and can confidently proceed to the next lesson.

items.title: Log Into Claude and Check Connector Slot
items.description:
Abrir o Claude no navegador e entrar com a conta escolhida.

Acessar Claude > Personalizar > Conectores (Customize > Connectors) e verificar se já existe algum conector personalizado. No plano gratuito, havendo um, será necessário removê-lo no Módulo 3.

items.title: Verify OS and Claude Desktop Feasibility
items.description: Verificar o sistema operacional do computador e decidir se o Claude Desktop será instalado.

items.title: (Optional) Check ChatGPT for MCP Server Support
items.description: Opcional: abrir ChatGPT > Plugins (ou Apps) e verificar se o botão + oferece a opção Add custom MCP server.

items.title: Fill Out Verification Record
items.description: Preencher o registro de verificação da subseção Mão na massa.

items.paragraph:
Situação Causa provável Procedimento
Personalizar não aparece na barra lateral Interface em transição ou idioma Procurar "Customize" ou o ícone de configurações; os nomes do diretório unificado mudaram em 2026
Conta Team/Enterprise sem conectores Bloqueio pela organização Utilizar conta pessoal; a habilitação cabe ao proprietário da organização
ChatGPT sem Plugins nem Apps Plano, região ou implantação Registrar "indisponível" e seguir o curso no Claude
Computador sem permissão de instalação Política corporativa Seguir a alternativa web do Módulo 4

items.heading: MCP Setup & Troubleshooting Flashcards
items.paragraph: Review each flashcard to reinforce your understanding of key terms and concepts essential for MCP setup and troubleshooting.

back.description: Claude offers Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans. All support MCP connectors, but the free plan allows only one custom connector.
A connector slot is the space available to add a custom connector in Claude. Free plans allow one; check availability before proceeding.
Claude Desktop requires macOS 13+, Windows 10+, or Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian 12+). Installation may need IT approval on work devices.
ChatGPT may show Plugins or Apps, and only some accounts allow adding a custom MCP server. Availability depends on plan and rollout.

items.title: Which Claude account plans allow you to use MCP connectors?

answers.title: Only Pro and Max
answers.feedback: Incorrect. All plans, including Free, support MCP connectors.

answers.title: Only Team and Enterprise
answers.feedback: Incorrect. All plans, including Free, support MCP connectors.

answers.title: All plans, including Free
answers.feedback: Correct! All Claude plans support MCP connectors, but the Free plan allows only one custom connector.
